s.zh: 两只公鸡在院子里斗来斗去。
s.en: Two roosters are fighting in the yard.

s.zh: 小猫和小狗斗着玩，真好玩。
s.en: The kitten and the puppy play-fight, it is so fun.

s.zh: 快八点了，我们要赶去学校。
s.en: It is almost eight, we have to hurry to school.

s.zh: 爸爸赶在下雨前回到家。
s.en: Dad hurried home before the rain started.

s.zh: 我们赶到车站时，巴士已经走了。
s.en: When we rushed to the bus stop, the bus had already left.
The doctor arrived very quickly.
It is going to rain, hurry home!

s.zh: 弟弟醒了，赶快去看看他。
s.en: My little brother is awake, quickly go and check on him.
The puppy is chasing the kitten.

s.zh: 我追赶前面的同学，可是追不上。
s.en: I chased the classmate in front, but couldn't catch up.

s.zh: 我每天先做完功课再玩。
s.en: Every day I finish my homework before playing.

s.zh: 这次能拿第一，大家都有功。
s.en: We came first this time, and everyone played a part.
This phone can do lots of things.
What can the new fridge do?
I only go and play after finishing my homework.
There is a lot of homework today.

s.zh: 我试了三次，最后成功了！
s.en: I tried three times and finally did it!
If you work hard, you will succeed.

s.zh: 我最喜欢的一科是华文。
s.en: My favourite subject is Chinese.
Which subject is your test tomorrow?
I want to be a scientist.

s.zh: 今天的科学课很有意思。
s.en: Today's science lesson was very interesting.

s.zh: 我将来要做一个好老师。
s.en: In the future I will be a good teacher.
There will be heavy rain tomorrow.
I want to be a doctor in the future.
What do you want to do in the future?
When I grow up I want to be a driver.
My little sister plays the teacher in the game.
I was only five years old at that time.
Everyone laughed at that time.
We went to eat the local snacks.
The local people were all very friendly.

s.zh: 你来我家玩，我当然高兴！
s.en: Of course I am happy you came to play at my home!
Of course I remember your birthday.
Our school bus driver's family name is Li.
This driver drives very carefully.
Dad goes to his company to work every day.
Mum's company is in the city centre.

s.zh: 巴士司机对我们说早安。
s.en: The bus driver said good morning to us.

s.zh: 司机叔叔每天早上送我们上学。
s.en: The driver takes us to school every morning.
I really hope it does not rain tomorrow.

s.zh: 大家都希望你快点好起来。
s.en: Everyone hopes you get well soon.
He stands at the door looking outside.
I looked up at the stars in the sky.
I hope I can go to the zoo.
Mum hopes I study hard.

s.zh: 我的生日愿望是有一只小狗。
s.en: My birthday wish is to have a puppy.
What is your New Year wish?
At the weekend we visit Grandma.

s.zh: 同学们去医院看望老师。
s.en: The classmates visited the teacher in hospital.

s.zh: 国庆日那天，我看到很多军车。
s.en: On National Day I saw many army trucks.

s.zh: 军人叔叔在国庆日表演。
s.en: Soldiers perform on National Day.
My cousin is a soldier.
Soldiers stand very straight.
That man is the school's security guard.

s.zh: 门卫叔叔每天在门口站着。
s.en: The guard stands at the gate every day.
Washing hands before meals is hygienic.

s.zh: 吃东西前要洗手，讲卫生。
s.en: Wash your hands before eating, keep things clean.
Excuse me, where is the bathroom?
Keep the bathroom clean.
There are many satellites in the sky.

s.zh: 卫星可以帮我们看天气。
s.en: Satellites can help us see the weather.
I practise skipping every day.
My brother is practising his handwriting.
We are practising skipping.
Practise more and you will write better.

s.zh: 游泳教练教我在水里吹泡泡。
s.en: The swimming coach taught me to blow bubbles in the water.
The coach told us to run two laps first.

s.zh: 只要我们一起努力，一定能做到。
s.en: If we all work hard together, we can surely do it.
He works very hard and wakes up early every day.
I will work hard to learn Chinese well.
She practised hard and came first.

s.zh: 老师叫我们写一篇日记。
s.en: The teacher asked us to write a diary entry.
I have read this story three times.

s.zh: 我今天读了一篇好故事。
s.en: I read a good story today.

s.zh: 姐姐写了一篇很长的作文。
s.en: My sister wrote a very long composition.
I wrote this composition.
This lesson text is very interesting.

s.zh: 妈妈每天帮我复习生字。
s.en: Mum helps me revise new words every day.

s.zh: 这个字我反复写了很多次。
s.en: I wrote this character over and over again.
Before the test I revise at home.

s.zh: 我和妈妈一起复习生字。
s.en: Mum and I revise the new words together.
Please repeat it once more.

s.zh: 弟弟总是重复我说的话。
s.en: My little brother always repeats what I say.
I read this book over and over.

s.zh: 老师反复说上课要专心。
s.en: The teacher said again and again that we must focus in class.
I handed my homework to the teacher.
Have you handed in your homework?

s.zh: 请把这本书交给你妈妈。
s.en: Please give this book to your mum.

s.zh: 老师把这件事交给我做。
s.en: The teacher left this job to me.
I like making friends.
My brother is good at making friends.
We talk to each other in Chinese.

s.zh: 下课后，我们交流看过的书。
s.en: After class we share the books we have read.
Classmates with questions, please raise your hand.
He lifted up a big stone.
I knew the answer and put up my hand at once.
Put up your hand before you speak in class.
The school is holding its sports day tomorrow.

s.zh: 我们在公园举行生日会。
s.en: We held a birthday party in the park.

s.zh: 我们班举办了一个画画比赛。
s.en: Our class held a drawing competition.

s.zh: 图书馆举办了讲故事的活动。
s.en: The library held a storytelling event.
The wind blew the book open.

s.zh: 小猫翻了一个身，又睡了。
s.en: The kitten rolled over and went back to sleep.
Everyone, please open your books in class.
He turns the pages very quickly.
Please open your textbook to page ten.

s.zh: 我翻开书，看到一张图画。
s.en: I opened the book and saw a picture.
Our class monitor's family name is Chen.
Teacher Chen teaches us Chinese.
My good friend's family name is Hu.
Grandpa's white beard is very long.
Dad shaves in the morning.

s.zh: 这只老山羊有长长的胡子。
s.en: This old goat has a long beard.
Don't talk nonsense!

s.zh: 弟弟胡说，我没有拿他的笔。
s.en: My brother is talking nonsense, I didn't take his pen.

s.zh: 上课的时候不可以胡闹。
s.en: You must not fool around in class.

s.zh: 你们别胡闹了，快去睡觉！
s.en: Stop fooling around and go to sleep!

s.zh: 李老师今天穿了红衣服。
s.en: Teacher Li is wearing red today.
My deskmate's family name is Li.
Our luggage is very heavy.
Dad put the luggage into the car.
This plum is very sweet.
I bought some plums.
The new classmate's family name is Wu.
Auntie Wu is our neighbour.
He sat to one side without saying a word.

s.zh: 大家你一言我一语，好热闹。
s.en: Everyone chatted away, it was very lively.
Chinese is a language.
She can speak three languages.
I put up my hand to speak in class.
Today I was the first to speak.
Excuse me, what is your family name?
Dad and I both have the family name Chen.
My Chinese teacher's family name is Wu.
Would the classmate named Wu please stand up?
That tall boy's family name is Li.
There are three people named Li in our class.
Most of my classmates are named Chen.
My neighbour is also named Chen.
This puppy doesn't have a name yet.

s.zh: 她在跑步比赛中得了第一名！
s.en: She came first in the running race!
What is your name?
Your name sounds really nice!
This chicken rice stall is very famous.
She is a famous writer.

s.zh: 请在这里写上你的姓名。
s.en: Please write your full name here.

s.zh: 老师一个一个叫我们的姓名。
s.en: The teacher called our names one by one.
My kitten is very chubby.
He ate lots of sweets and got fat.
This panda is very chubby and very cute.
The piglet is very fat and eats a lot.
My little brother has a chubby face.
The chubby puppy came running over.
My sister is tall and thin.
The kitten was sick and got much thinner.
That puppy is very thin.
He is very thin but very strong.
You have got thinner recently.

s.zh: 爸爸每天跑步，瘦了很多。
s.en: Dad runs every day and has lost a lot of weight.
I am shorter than my brother.
This table is too low.
This tree is short and small.

s.zh: 他个子矮小，可是跑得很快。
s.en: He is small and short, but runs very fast.
This tree is very short.
The door is very low, mind your head!
The teacher is pleased with my homework.
This is a good idea!
Do you have any ideas about it?
Let's listen to what everyone thinks.
Will you be my friend?
I am happy to help you.
Sorry, I didn't do it on purpose.
He kicked the ball to me on purpose.

s.zh: 妈妈对我画的画很满意。
s.en: Mum is pleased with my drawing.
Are you happy with this present?
I was careless and wrote the wrong character.
You must not be careless in a test.
I don't understand what this character means.

s.zh: 他想了又想，思考了很久。
s.en: He thought it over for a long time.
What does this character mean?
I don't understand what you mean.
This story is very interesting.
Today's activity was really fun!

s.zh: 这个问题，我们先思考一下。
s.en: Let's think about this question first.

s.zh: 他坐在那里，一直在思考。
s.en: He sat there, thinking all the while.
My aunt is coming to our home next month.
My aunt bought me a book.
My aunt is Dad's older sister.
I love playing with my aunt.
We talked for a long time.

s.zh: 老师和妈妈在谈我的功课。
s.en: The teacher and Mum are talking about my homework.
The teacher wanted to have a talk with me.

s.zh: 妈妈和老师的谈话很长。
s.en: Mum and the teacher talked for a long time.
I can't do this question.
The teacher set ten questions.
Can I ask a question?
This question is very hard.
Who can do this hard question?
My brother taught me how to do this hard question.

s.zh: 我们找一个新的话题吧。
s.en: Let's find something new to talk about.

s.zh: 小狗是我们最爱的话题。
s.en: Dogs are our favourite thing to talk about.
Please step back and let me pass.

s.zh: 水退了，我们可以出去了。
s.en: The water has gone down, we can go out now.
My brother left the football team.

s.zh: 他不想玩了，就退出了游戏。
s.en: He didn't want to play any more, so he left the game.

s.zh: 我们不去看电影了，要去退票。
s.en: We are not going to the movie, so we will return the tickets.
Can this ticket be returned?
I wrote a letter to Grandma.
I believe what you said.
I feel confident about the test.
You must believe in yourself!
I believe you can do it.

s.zh: 妈妈相信我说的是真话。
s.en: Mum believes I told the truth.

s.zh: 爸爸给我发了一个短信。
s.en: Dad sent me a text message.
I got a text message from my sister.
I am writing a letter to my good friend.
Can you write a letter in Chinese?
Mum keeps me company while I do my homework.
Will you come shopping with me?
The puppy keeps Grandma company every day.
Thank you for always being with me.
I put the books into my schoolbag.

s.zh: 这个大箱子可以装很多东西。
s.en: This big box can hold lots of things.
A worker came to put in our air-con.

s.zh: 爸爸在电脑上安装了新游戏。
s.en: Dad installed a new game on the computer.

s.zh: 商场里有很多漂亮的服装。
s.en: There are lots of pretty clothes in the mall.

s.zh: 我们穿上漂亮的服装表演。
s.en: We put on pretty costumes to perform.

s.zh: 路上有一辆红色的巴士。
s.en: There is a red bus on the road.
Two cars are parked at the door.
There are many vehicles on the road.
Watch out for vehicles when you cross the road.
A car is parked downstairs.
Dad bought a car.

s.zh: 妈妈把要买的东西写在单子上。
s.en: Mum wrote what to buy on a list.
I can stand on one foot for a minute.
The teacher is looking at the list of names for the competition.
My name is on the list!
Please show me the menu.

s.zh: 菜单上有我爱吃的鸡饭。
s.en: My favourite chicken rice is on the menu.
Today we are learning Unit Three.
There are many new words in this unit.
This cake is super tasty!
My puppy runs super fast.
Mum and I go to the supermarket to buy food.
There is lots of fruit in the supermarket.
He overtook me in the race.
There are more than a hundred people here.
This game is super fun!
My sister is super good at drawing.
Please press the doorbell.

s.zh: 他按了一下电梯的开关。
s.en: He pressed the lift button.
Please do as the teacher says.
We line up by height.
I go to bed on time every day.
Please hand in your homework on time.
Someone is ringing the doorbell.
I rang the doorbell and Grandma opened the door.
Please put the lid on properly.
Mum tucked the blanket over me.

s.zh: 这个盒子的盖子打不开。
s.en: This box's lid won't open.
Please pass me the lid.
After drinking, put the lid back on the cup.

s.zh: 天冷了，奶奶给我盖上被子。
s.en: It got cold, so Grandma covered me with a blanket.
I drink the juice through a straw.
The baby is sucking a dummy.
This book really draws me in.

s.zh: 花香吸引了很多小蜜蜂。
s.en: The smell of the flowers attracted many little bees.
The grass takes in water from the soil.

s.zh: 这块毛巾能吸收很多水。
s.en: This towel can soak up a lot of water.
I will take care of this.
I look after my own things.
I don't use a straw for my drinks.
This straw is green.
Grandpa waters the flowers with a hose.
The water pipe broke and water went everywhere.
This ball bounces very high.
My sister is playing the guitar in her room.
The clock on the wall has stopped.
The school bell rang, class is over!
I will be there in only five minutes.
Can you wait for me one more minute?
The alarm clock is ringing, get up!

s.zh: 我的闹钟是一只小猫的样子。
s.en: My alarm clock looks like a kitten.

s.zh: 我做功课做了一个钟头。
s.en: I did my homework for an hour.
We waited for two hours.
Dad's back is very broad.

s.zh: 我背对着门，没看见他进来。
s.en: I had my back to the door and didn't see him come in.
He is hiding behind the door.
There is a puppy behind me.
My back is all sweaty.
Mum helps me wash my back.
Mum makes pancakes with flour.
This cake is pink.
Mum makes the baby's milk.
There are many kinds of milk powder in the supermarket.

s.zh: 妹妹的鞋子是粉红色的。
s.en: My sister's shoes are pink.
Pink is my favourite colour.

s.zh: 这块饼干是星星形状的。
s.en: This biscuit is shaped like a star.
The clouds keep changing shape.
What shape do you like?

s.zh: 这片叶子的形状像一只手。
s.en: This leaf is shaped like a hand.
My watch keeps good time.
He kicks the ball very accurately.

s.zh: 我们明天早上八点准时出发。
s.en: We leave at eight sharp tomorrow morning.
The bus is on time today.
If you write a character wrong, correct it.
Let's go to the park another day.

s.zh: 天气改变了，我们不去海边了。
s.en: The weather changed, so we are not going to the beach.
I changed my mind.

s.zh: 老师叫我改正写错的字。
s.en: The teacher asked me to correct the wrong characters.
When you know you are wrong, put it right.
Sorry, I am late.
The bus came very late today.

s.zh: 下雨了，比赛推迟到明天。
s.en: It rained, so the match was put off to tomorrow.
Our trip has been put off.
Hurry, or we will be late!
He was late for school today.

s.zh: 我每天早上喝牛奶，喝惯了。
s.en: I drink milk every morning, I'm used to it.
I have got used to living in our new home.
I am used to going to bed early and getting up early.
Washing hands before meals is a good habit.
The homework must be handed in within three days.
Everyone, please wait for me inside the classroom.
This book has very interesting contents.

s.zh: 你还记得故事的内容吗？
s.en: Do you still remember what the story was about?
It is raining, so we play indoors.
No running around indoors.
Please put the books into your schoolbag.
The little bird flew into the woods.
Where is the zoo's entrance?
We will wait for you at the entrance.
We went into the cave.
Please come into the classroom and sit down.
I will be the one to do this.

s.zh: 今天的晚饭由爸爸来煮。
s.en: Dad is cooking dinner today.
The little bird flies freely in the sky.

s.zh: 我们放小鱼回河里，让它自由。
s.en: We let the little fish go back into the river to be free.
This little river is very shallow.

s.zh: 她穿了一件浅绿色的衣服。
s.en: She is wearing a light green top.

s.zh: 这里的水很浅，可以下去玩。
s.en: The water here is very shallow, we can go in.

s.zh: 这个盘子很浅，装不了汤。
s.en: This plate is too shallow to hold soup.
I like light-coloured clothes.
The pale flowers are very pretty.

s.zh: 这里的水很深，不要下去。
s.en: The water here is deep, don't go in.
The sky is dark blue.
This hole is very deep.
The river is very deep, be careful!

s.zh: 小朋友不能去深水的地方。
s.en: Children must not go into deep water.

s.zh: 他会游泳，可以在深水里游。
s.en: He can swim, so he can swim in deep water.

s.zh: 这条路很窄，车子过不去。
s.en: This road is too narrow for cars.

s.zh: 门太窄了，桌子搬不进来。
s.en: The door is too narrow to bring the table in.
This little path is very narrow.

s.zh: 楼梯很窄，要一个一个走。
s.en: The stairs are very narrow, go one at a time.
This road is very wide.
This river is very wide.
Our school field is very wide.

s.zh: 这张床很宽，可以睡三个人。
s.en: This bed is wide enough for three people.
The ice cubes melted into water.
The sun came out and all the ice melted.
The weather changes a lot.

s.zh: 一年没见，你的变化真大！
s.en: You have changed so much in a year!

s.zh: 吃饭不要太快，才好消化。
s.en: Don't eat too fast, so your food digests well.

s.zh: 吃太多了，肚子消化不了。
s.en: I ate too much, my tummy can't cope.
The rain is getting heavier and heavier.
He runs faster and faster.
The weather is getting hotter and hotter.
My Chinese is getting better and better.

s.zh: 我的妹妹还在上幼儿园。
s.en: My little sister is still in kindergarten.
That was my old kindergarten.
My little brother goes to kindergarten every day.
The kindergarten teachers are very kind.
I forgot to water it, and the little flower died.
The little fish died and we were very sad.

s.zh: 桌上摆着很多好吃的菜。
s.en: There are lots of tasty dishes laid out on the table.
The wind makes the branches swing back and forth.
The puppy's tail is wagging.

s.zh: 风一吹，小草就摆动起来。
s.en: When the wind blows, the grass sways.
Please put your shoes away neatly.
Many books are set out on the bookshelf.
My legs are very long.
After running, my legs are so tired.
I love ham sandwiches.
Mum is making ham fried rice.
The puppy stood up on its back legs.
A frog's back legs are very long.

s.zh: 弟弟坐在爸爸的大腿上。
s.en: My little brother sits on Dad's lap.
The baby has chubby thighs.

s.zh: 吃东西时不要张开嘴说话。
s.en: Don't talk with your mouth open when you eat.

s.zh: 小鸟张开嘴，等妈妈给它吃东西。
s.en: The baby bird opens its mouth for its mum to feed it.

s.zh: 请张开嘴巴，让医生看看。
s.en: Please open your mouth and let the doctor look.
He has rice all over his mouth.

s.zh: 他们为了一点小事吵嘴。
s.en: They argued over a little thing.
Even good friends argue sometimes.

s.zh: 大家七嘴八舌地说个不停。
s.en: Everyone is talking at once and won't stop.

s.zh: 同学们七嘴八舌，老师听不清。
s.en: The classmates all talked at once, and the teacher couldn't hear.

s.zh: 哥哥和姐姐又在斗嘴了。
s.en: My brother and sister are bickering again.

s.zh: 我们只是斗嘴，不是吵架。
s.en: We are only teasing each other, not quarrelling.
Mum is calling me for dinner.

s.zh: 有人在外面喊我的名字。
s.en: Someone outside is calling my name.
Don't shout in the library.
The children are shouting on the field.

s.zh: 球进了，大家都大喊起来。
s.en: The ball went in and everyone shouted.

s.zh: 我在山上大喊，听到了回声。
s.en: I shouted on the hill and heard an echo.

s.zh: 妈妈给我披上一条毛巾。
s.en: Mum put a towel round my shoulders.
Her long hair hangs down her back.
It's cold, put on your jacket.

s.zh: 我披上被子，坐在沙发上看电视。
s.en: I wrapped a blanket round me and watched TV on the sofa.

s.zh: 我穿上红色的披风，好像会飞。
s.en: I put on a red cape and feel like I can fly.

s.zh: 他的披风被风吹起来了。
s.en: His cape was blown up by the wind.
The puppy peeks out from behind the door.
She smiled and showed her white teeth.

s.zh: 太阳从云里露出了笑脸。
s.en: The sun showed its face from behind the clouds.

s.zh: 小猫从被子里露出头来。
s.en: The kitten poked its head out of the blanket.
In the morning there is lots of dew on the grass.

s.zh: 叶子上的露水亮晶晶的。
s.en: The dew on the leaves is sparkly.
I ate until my tummy was full.
The kitten has a white tummy.
My tummy is hungry.

s.zh: 他吃了三碗饭，肚子圆圆的。
s.en: He ate three bowls of rice and his tummy is round.
His mind works very quickly.
Use your brain more and you will find a way.
I draw on the computer.
My brother does his homework on the computer.
He is very smart.
Use your head when you do things.
We think with our brains.
Reading a lot is good for your brain.
We went to see an art show.
Mum opened out the picture to show me.
Mum opened out the map.
I unfolded the letter to read it.
Our family went on a trip.
This trip was great fun.
There are lots of travellers at the airport.
The passengers on the ship are looking at the sea.

s.zh: 爸爸带我们去中国旅游。

s.en: The little stone sank straight away.
Mum measures how tall I am.

s.zh: 医生给我量了一下体温。
s.en: The doctor took my temperature.

s.zh: 我们商量一下去哪里玩。
s.en: Let's talk about where to go and play.
Talk things over with your family.
When everyone works together, we are stronger.
He is very strong.

s.zh: 我们来量一量这张桌子。
s.en: Let's measure this table.

s.zh: 量一量，看你长高了没有。
s.en: Let's measure and see if you have grown.
The teacher praised my handwriting.
Everyone praised him for being clever.
His eyes are bright and lively.
This story is truly magical.
I like reading myths.
This is a very old legend.
Nature is truly amazing.
This little trick is amazing.
